#!/usr/bin/env python3
import csv
import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Input file
    input_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"

    # Output files
    report_path = "outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv"
    selected_path = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"

    # Read data
    df = pd.read_csv(
        input_path,
        dtype={'city_id':str, 'city_name':str, 'year':int},
        engine='python'
    )

    # Indicator columns are all columns except the first three
    indicator_cols = df.columns.tolist()[3:]

    # Compute missingness
    missing_counts = df[indicator_cols].isna().sum()
    total_rows = len(df)
    missing_rates = missing_counts / total_rows
    kept = missing_rates <= 0.30

    # Build report DataFrame
    report_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'indicator': indicator_cols,
        'missing_count': missing_counts.values,
        'missing_rate': missing_rates.values,
        'kept': kept.values
    })

    # Write report with minimal quoting
    report_df.to_csv(
        report_path,
        index=False,
        quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
        line_terminator='\n'
    )

    # Build selected matrix
    selected_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + [
        col for col, k in zip(indicator_cols, kept) if k
    ]
    selected_df = df[selected_cols]

    # Write selected matrix
    selected_df.to_csv(
        selected_path,
        index=False,
        quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
        line_terminator='\n'
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
